verdict.rationale: Omarchy is a desktop Linux distro, so headless or automated operation is a fair axis. Its own docs show some non-interactive automation: an `omarchy` CLI that agents can drive for configuration, and a manual page on unattended installs. Nothing documents running Omarchy headlessly, without its Hyprland desktop, or inside a CI pipeline. Missing for 10: documented headless mode, CI integration or examples, details of the unattended install process, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run the product headlessly / in CI for automation

citations.quote: you can also control it through the `omarchy` CLI. This is particularly helpful when you're having an AI agent work with you on customization or configuration.
The manual also covers dual booting beside Windows and unattended installs.
You can also use the cli with `omarchy reminder 7 'Tea ready'`.
